channel.title: Crypto Docket
channel.description: Crypto Docket reports news across crypto: Bitcoin and Ethereum, layer-2 networks, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation and security incidents.

item.title: How to connect a Ledger to SyncSwap for a first swap
item.description: Learn how to connect Ledger to SyncSwap with MetaMask: add your hardware wallet, choose a supported network, review the quote and approve your first swap.

item.title: ETH on Arbitrum: get Lido rewards through wstETH
item.description: To stake ETH with Lido when your ETH is on Arbitrum, swap for wstETH there or route to wstETH on Ethereum, then track its value in ETH.

item.title: Bridge aggregators: why a supported chain can still have no route
item.description: Why bridge aggregators support some chains but not others comes down to deployed bridges, token liquidity and the chain pairs each route can serve.

item.title: How to bridge tokens with lifi bridge and confirm arrival
item.description: To bridge tokens with lifi bridge, connect your wallet, compare the amount received, approve and sign the transfer, then track its source hash until tokens arrive.

item.title: Ethereum sets Dec. 15 Hoodi test for Glamsterdam
item.description: Ethereum developers rescheduled Glamsterdam on Hoodi for Dec. 15 and kept its gas changes intact, reopening testing after an October delay without setting a mainnet date.

item.title: How to Confirm a Wallet Can Receive on a Network
item.description: To check if a wallet supports a blockchain before sending funds, open its receive screen on that network, confirm the address, and wait for a test transfer to appear.

item.title: DeFi staking yields across protocols: compare them on one basis
item.description: Compare DeFi staking yields across protocols using net 30-day returns in one unit, separating fees from emissions and accounting for exits and loss risk.

item.title: TVL in DeFi: What the Number Measures About Safety
item.description: What is TVL in DeFi and does it matter for safety? It measures deposited value, not code or control risk; use it with audits, oracle and admin checks.

item.title: ZK rollup: How transactions are proved on Ethereum
item.description: What is a zk rollup and how does it work in simple terms? It runs transactions off Ethereum and posts a validity proof so Ethereum can verify the result.

item.title: Sepolia Faucet Requirements: Balance, Login or CPU Time
item.description: Sepolia faucet requirements compared: provider faucets may ask for mainnet ETH or an account, while proof of work trades browser mining time for test ETH.

item.title: Why DeFi Loans Need a Buffer Before Liquidation
item.description: Why do DeFi loans need more collateral than the loan amount? Volatile collateral needs a buffer so it can be sold before a price drop leaves debt uncovered.

item.title: MetaMask Says Wrong Network on Polygon Portal: Choose the Right Chain
item.description: When MetaMask says wrong network on Polygon Portal, its selected chain differs from the current step; switch to Ethereum or Polygon PoS, then retry safely.

item.title: ShibaSwap: How Token Swaps Work
item.description: What is shiba swap? It is a decentralized exchange app for swapping tokens, adding liquidity and staking through a wallet, with no account or custodian.

item.title: EU’s 22nd Russia sanctions proposal puts crypto in focus
item.description: The Commission’s 22nd Russia sanctions proposal would cut 60 banks from SWIFT and widen crypto scrutiny, but needs unanimous EU approval to take effect.

item.title: How Does Pool Depth Affect a DEX Swap Price?
item.description: How liquidity depth affects a DEX swap price: deeper reserves usually mean less price impact, so a swap’s quote stays closer to the pre-trade rate.

item.title: How do you check DeFi risk before depositing funds?
item.description: How to check a DeFi protocol's risk before depositing funds: match audits to live contracts, inspect admin delays, review incidents, and trace asset risks.

item.title: MetaMask not connecting to Polygon Portal? Fix the wallet handoff
item.description: MetaMask not connecting to Polygon Portal? Unlock the extension, approve its pending request and select MetaMask when another wallet takes the connection.

item.title: Why a Bridge Needs ERC-20 Approval Before Depositing
item.description: Why does bridging need an approval transaction first? An ERC-20 bridge uses transferFrom, which needs an allowance set with approve before it can record your deposit.
